asset_authority.description: Verify the Player V1/V2 asset-authority boundary: manifest fields, quarantined V1 sources, required READMEs, and prohibited V1 references under Player V2. Path and manifest checks only; it cannot prove mesh originality.

default.description: The whole structural boundary check. Takes no arguments and writes nothing.

player_v2_motion_review.description: Run the Player V2 deterministic motion-review capture suite headlessly through the repository's Godot runner. It observes the committed motion package and judges no visual quality.

headless.description: Headless capture suite. Results and the suite log are written to the run directory.
